excerpt: I know I need to start, but when I look at the assignment it feels huge. I usually end up doing something small and easy instead because at least I know I can finish that.
I tend to avoid it until I understand exactly what the lecturer wants. If the instructions are vague, I keep telling myself I need more information before I can begin.
I normally start late because starting makes me think about whether I am good enough to do it. Once I actually begin, it is usually nowhere near as bad as I imagined.
I work better when somebody gives me something specific to do. If the assignment just says discuss, I can spend hours thinking about how to approach it without writing anything.
I sometimes do other productive things. I clean, answer emails, organise files. It feels like work, but really I am avoiding the thing I am worried about.
